title: Lantern Menagerie: The Three-Moon Shadow Reel
summary: A four-part hand-powered moon gate whose captured reel casts indexed rabbit, compact-eared fox, and beaked owl shadows from an ordinary phone flashlight. Round 4 preserves the verified two-way mechanism while clarifying both animal profiles, the assembled reset pairing, the phone/beam cue, and the rear-shell fine-wall margin.
materials: Common rigid FFF filament; PLA or PETG candidates are not physically qualified in Make.
limitations: Digital geometry and projection checks do not prove a successful print, snap fit, detent feel, cycle life, human recognition, phone brightness, finite-emitter edge softness, or performance in a particular room.
Only the 0, 120, and 240 degree indexed states promise rabbit, fox, and owl; the transitions are intentional eclipse wipes.
Rigid-body sweeps exclude the front leaf's intended elastic detent contact. Nominal ramps and clearances do not prove printed force, strain, retention, or durability.
